# Chunked Implementation Skill

Implement only one approved vertical slice at a time. Slice must be small enough to understand, review and test independently, but complete across relevant layers. Before coding: check clean/known Git state, parent requirement, AC IDs, approved contracts/design, dependencies, acceptance tests, risk and rollback. Then implement the smallest coherent change. Run targeted tests after each meaningful edit, followed by full slice checks. Do not start the next slice until independent review and human acceptance. Avoid broad rewrites and unrelated cleanup.
